findings.title: DMARC not enforced (p=none): domain can be spoofed for BEC/wire fraud

evidence.excerpt: DMARC record: v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@brightwaterfleet.example; policy: none, pct: 100

findings.deal_impact: DMARC at p=none allows domain spoofing attempts to pass, increasing BEC/wire-fraud and phishing risk to customers and counterparties; remediation is usually straightforward but requires mail-flow validation.

remediation.summary: Move DMARC from p=none to quarantine then reject after monitoring rua reports and validating all senders.

findings.title: SPF uses soft/neutral fail

evidence.excerpt: SPF record: v=spf1 include:_spf.mailhost.example include:sendgrid.example ~all; qualifier: ~all, lookup_count: 2

findings.deal_impact: Softfail SPF weakens enforcement against unauthorized senders and compounds the DMARC p=none exposure for spoofing.

remediation.summary: Inventory authorized senders, then change SPF from ~all to -all in coordination with DMARC enforcement.

findings.title: DNSSEC not enabled

evidence.excerpt: DNSSEC check: queried_name brightwaterfleet.example, record_type DS, enabled: false

findings.deal_impact: Without DNSSEC, DNS responses lack authenticated integrity, modestly increasing spoofing/redirection risk for web and mail services.

remediation.summary: Enable DNSSEC at the registrar/DNS provider and publish DS records, with monitoring for resolution failures.

findings.title: Publicly logged hostnames suggest exposed admin/legacy/staging systems

evidence.excerpt: Risky hostname vpn.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern vpn, first_seen 2023-02-11, last_seen 2026-09-30
Risky hostname jenkins-old.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern jenkins|old, first_seen 2021-06-03, last_seen 2026-08-14
Risky hostname staging-api.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern staging, first_seen 2024-01-20, last_seen 2026-10-01
Risky hostname legacy-portal.brightwaterfleet.example, pattern legacy, first_seen 2019-11-05, last_seen 2026-07-22; risky_hostnames_count 4

findings.deal_impact: CT-logged VPN, old Jenkins, staging API and legacy portal names signal potentially exposed or poorly retired systems that merit validation in confirmatory diligence; presence alone does not prove they are reachable.

remediation.summary: Validate reachability and ownership of risky hostnames, decommission or restrict legacy/staging/admin systems, and enforce MFA/patching on VPN.

findings.title: Large certificate footprint relative to company size

evidence.excerpt: CT query returned unique_hostnames: 47, risky_hostnames_count: 4 for a 201-1000 employee company

findings.deal_impact: 47 unique hostnames suggests attack-surface sprawl that may include forgotten assets, increasing inventory and patch-management burden post-close.

remediation.summary: Reconcile all 47 CT hostnames to an authoritative asset inventory and remove or consolidate unowned/stale services.

findings.title: Deprecated TLS versions offered

evidence.excerpt: tls_support TLSv1.0: true, TLSv1.1: true, TLSv1.2: true; tls_versions [TLSv1.0, TLSv1.1, TLSv1.2]

findings.deal_impact: Offering TLS 1.0/1.1 on www weakens transport security and may affect compliance/customer security reviews.

remediation.summary: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 on www and other web endpoints, retaining TLS 1.2+.

findings.title: HSTS not set
findings.deal_impact: Missing HSTS leaves first-visit/downgrade exposure and is a common low-cost gap flagged in customer and insurer security reviews.

remediation.summary: Add Strict-Transport-Security header on apex and www after confirming HTTPS-only operation.

findings.title: Internet-facing appliance listed in CISA KEV (version not verified)

evidence.excerpt: KEV match CVE-PLACEHOLDER-0001, vendor ExampleGate, product ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version 7.0.11, match_tier appliance_exposed, match_level product; note: KEV lists products, not affected versions; version not verified. Snapshot 2026-10-20.
Fingerprint product ExampleGate SSL-VPN, version 7.0.11, kind appliance, source asset_path on www host

findings.deal_impact: Potential exposure: an internet-facing ExampleGate SSL-VPN fingerprint matches a CISA KEV-listed product (version not verified), so patch level must be urgently confirmed pre-close as VPN appliances are high-value targets.

remediation.summary: Immediately verify ExampleGate SSL-VPN version/patch against KEV CVE, patch or isolate the appliance, and review for compromise indicators.

findings.title: Publicly disclosed security incident in the last 24 months

evidence.excerpt: State AG breach notice dated 2025-08-14: unauthorized access to a customer support system; approx. 3,100 individuals notified. Entity match exact; disclosed_within_months: 14.

findings.deal_impact: A disclosed breach 14 months ago affecting ~3,100 individuals raises regulatory, notification, litigation and insurability diligence, and requires review of root cause and remediation closure.

remediation.summary: Obtain breach investigation, regulator correspondence and remediation evidence; confirm notification obligations closed and lessons implemented.
